summary_en: Year-end dividend per share raised from 60 yen to 70 yen for the fiscal year ending March 2027, lifting annual dividend from 120 yen to 130 yen, following upward revision of full-year earnings forecast driven by robust demand in semiconductor equipment and data center sectors.
title_en: Notice Regarding Upward Revision of Consolidated Business Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Tachibana Eletech has raised its year-end dividend per share for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 from 60 yen to 70 yen, an increase of 10 yen. Combined with the interim dividend of 60 yen paid in the second quarter, the revised full-year dividend is 130 yen per share, up from the previously forecast 120 yen.

The dividend increase follows an upward revision of the company's consolidated earnings forecast. Net income attributable to parent company shareholders is now projected at 7,500 million yen, up 7.1% from the prior forecast of 7,000 million yen. The stronger earnings reflect robust demand across semiconductor manufacturing equipment, data center infrastructure, and memory semiconductor sectors, with these tailwinds benefiting the company's business group broadly. Third-quarter results have tracked ahead of previous guidance, prompting the forecast upgrade.

According to the company's dividend policy, the increase represents profit returned to shareholders commensurate with improved operating performance. The previous year (fiscal year ended March 2026) paid 100 yen in annual dividend, consisting of 50 yen interim and 50 yen year-end.
